name: Razorquills raises Toxic Dart's tick-rate modifier by 20% without touching an unrelated Ranger spell (#2506)
contract: 705072 'Razorquills' reads 'Increases the tick rate of Toxic Dart and Emerald Arrows by 20%.' It is a single SPELL_AURA_ADD_PCT_MODIFIER, MiscValue 19 = SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, BasePoints -21+1=-20, class mask (32768, 0, 64) = word0 bit 15, word2 bit 6, narrowly scoped to two spells. Toxic Dart 807237 (SPELL_AURA_PERIODIC_DAMAGE) has SpellFamilyFlags (32768, 0, 0) = word0 bit 15, a direct match; the older, unrelated 707699 'Toxic Dart' record carries all-zero family flags and is untouched by this passive. AuraEffect::CalculatePeriodic (src/server/game/Spells/Auras/SpellAuraEffects.cpp) unconditionally applies modOwner->ApplySpellMod(id, SPELLMOD_ACTIVATION_TIME, amplitude) for every periodic aura matching the mask, so no script is needed.

steps.label: CONTRACT: Toxic Dart's tick-interval modifier drops to 80%
REGRESSION: the unrelated all-zero-mask Toxic Dart record is untouched
